inv.desc_en:
Premises adapted for an office in excellent condition in an unbeatable area of Ruzafa - Maestro Aguilar street - high foot traffic. It has 102 m2, distributed into four work areas plus a reception, a large bathroom and a half-bath, a small outdoor terrace facing the block courtyard, A/C, parquet-style stoneware floors, lighting; it is ready to move into. Adaptable to any activity. Ground floor facing the street with electric shutters, lights, ready to move into, last activity was an office, excellent area.
This advertisement is not binding, may contain errors, and is shown for informational and non-contractual purposes.
